```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
ROOT <- "/users/4/coffm049/papers/functionalBrainHerit"
# For local render (Windows) the same relative paths work; ROOT not needed for images
WIDE <- file.path(ROOT, "results/summary/mash_twin_wide.csv")
wide <- tryCatch(read_csv(WIDE, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())

fivenum_tbl <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x)==0) return(tibble(min=NA, q1=NA, median=NA, mean=NA, q3=NA, max=NA, n=0, sd=NA))
  tibble(
    min = min(x), q1 = quantile(x, 0.25), median = median(x),
    mean = mean(x), q3 = quantile(x, 0.75), max = max(x),
    n = length(x), sd = sd(x)
  )
}
```

## Gordon — Five-Number Summaries & Correlations

```{r gordon-stats}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5
if (nrow(wide)>0) {
  gordon_wide <- wide %>% filter(Set=="gordon")
  # Twin vs AdjHE-RE comparison for fivenum
  gordon_long <- gordon_wide %>%
    select(Pheno, Twin_h2, h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Twin_h2, h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE), names_to="Method", values_to="h2") %>%
    mutate(Method = recode(Method, Twin_h2="Twin", h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE="AdjHE-RE"))
  # fivenum per Method
  fivenum_gordon <- gordon_long %>%
    group_by(Method) %>% summarise(fivenum_tbl(h2), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x,3)))
  kable(fivenum_gordon, caption="Gordon — h2 five-number summary (Twin vs AdjHE-RE, 30 PCs)")
} else { cat("mash_twin_wide.csv not found — run 01_compare_mash_twin.R"); cat("\n") }
```

```{r gordon-corr}
if (file.exists(file.path(ROOT,"results/summary/correlations_by_set.csv"))) {
  corr <- read_csv(file.path(ROOT,"results/summary/correlations_by_set.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE)
  kable(corr %>% filter(Set=="gordon"), caption="Gordon — Twin vs MASH correlations")
} else if (nrow(wide)>0) {
  # fallback: compute from wide
  tmp <- gordon_wide %>% select(Twin_h2, h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE) %>% drop_na()
  if (nrow(tmp)>2) {
    kable(tibble(
      Set="gordon", Method="h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE", n=nrow(tmp),
      Pearson_r=cor(tmp$Twin_h2, tmp$h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE),
      Spearman_rho=cor(tmp$Twin_h2, tmp$h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE, method="spearman"),
      R2_pearson=cor(tmp$Twin_h2, tmp$h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE)^2
    ) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x,3))), caption="Gordon — Twin vs AdjHE-RE (computed)")
  }
}
```

## ProbaConns — Five-Number Summaries & Correlations

```{r proba-stats}
if (nrow(wide)>0) {
  proba_long <- wide %>% filter(Set=="probaConns") %>%
    select(Pheno, Twin_h2, h2_proba_AdjHE_RE) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Twin_h2, h2_proba_AdjHE_RE), names_to="Method", values_to="h2") %>%
    mutate(Method = recode(Method, Twin_h2="Twin", h2_proba_AdjHE_RE="AdjHE-RE"))
  fivenum_proba <- proba_long %>% group_by(Method) %>% summarise(fivenum_tbl(h2), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x,3)))
  kable(fivenum_proba, caption="ProbaConns — h2 five-number summary")
}
```

## SA w_total — Five-Number Summaries & Correlations

```{r sa-wtotal-stats}
# Try w_total columns if 01_compare_mash_twin.R has been updated to include them;
# otherwise this gracefully falls back to wo_total with a note.
wcols <- grep("w_total", names(wide), value=TRUE)
if (length(wcols)>0) {
  sa_w <- wide %>% filter(Set=="SA") %>% select(Pheno, all_of(wcols), Twin_h2) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(wcols), names_to="Method", values_to="h2") %>%
    mutate(Method = gsub("h2_SA_|_w_total", "", Method))
  fivenum_saw <- sa_w %>% group_by(Method) %>% summarise(fivenum_tbl(h2), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x,3)))
  kable(fivenum_saw, caption="SA w_total — h2 five-number summary (if w_total columns present)")
} else {
  cat("No w_total columns in mash_twin_wide.csv yet — run w_total SLURMs and rebuild 01_compare_mash_twin.R with w_total pattern.\n")
  if (file.exists(file.path(ROOT,"results/summary/r2_sa_w_vs_wo_total.csv"))) {
    kable(read_csv(file.path(ROOT,"results/summary/r2_sa_w_vs_wo_total.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE), caption="SA w_total vs wo_total R² (from 04_compare_r2.R)")
  }
}
```

```{r sa-wtotal-corr}
if (file.exists(file.path(ROOT,"results/summary/r2_sa_w_vs_wo_total.csv"))) {
  kable(read_csv(file.path(ROOT,"results/summary/r2_sa_w_vs_wo_total.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE), caption="SA w_total vs wo_total — Twin and AdjHE-RE R²")
}
```

## Run Order

```bash
Rscript summary/01_compare_mash_twin.R          # 01 → mash_twin_wide.csv
bash summary/02_run_brain_viz.sh                # 02a-d → Gordon/ProbaConns/SA surfaces+chords (proba fix: iter_structures for 29696 vs 32492)
Rscript summary/03_plot_sa_horizontal.R         # SA barplots: Twin vs AdjHE-RE dodged (wo_total + w_total, geom_col + position_dodge2)
Rscript summary/04_compare_r2.R                 # R² per Set + SA w/wo
python summary/05_manhattan.py                  # 05 → manhattans + overview (full x-axis, Sys-Sys labels; cf. 03-matrixManhattan2.py:174-249, 03c-matrixManhattan-separate.py:253-259) — overview now regenerated
quarto render summary/06_results_catalog.qmd --to html
```
